webSentetik.alinti: Lavender can be used sparingly in a Belgian dubbel to add a floral note.
Lavender is a popular addition to saison and witbier recipes.
Traditional German wheat beers use Hallertau, Spalt or occasionally Saaz.
Saaz is the classic hop of Czech pilsner.
Mint has been used in some summer ales and stouts.
Witbier is traditionally spiced with coriander and Curaçao orange peel.
